faq.q: How do I join a channel?
faq.a: Pick a plan in Plans and pay by KHQR, ABA, USDT or your wallet. The channel opens as soon as the payment is confirmed.
With a Copier Pass, connect your MT5 account and every signal in your channels is placed in it for you, at the size you choose.
